title: Catcraftia
description: The modpack for Catcraftia, the casual survival Minecraft server for CatWeb.
body:
# The Catcraftia modpack.
This is the modpack for the Minecraft server Catcraftia, which is a regular survival Minecraft server with keep inventory on. Imagine this server as a multiplayer survival world; this may help put it into perspective how the server feels and looks like.
This modpack only generally adds Vanilla+ mods.
